name: Farmer's Companion
notes: v1.0.2: Fixed Auto-Collect Livestock silently destroying wool/milk instead of giving it to the player, fixed the 3D Crop Health HUD showing growth near 100% within seconds of planting (minutes/seconds unit bug), fixed Tree Growth Boost only ever applying to literal palm trees, fixed a multiplayer network-ID collision on auto-replanted crops, and added the missing automatic Toast Notifications for auto-harvest/auto-collect events.
